objective: Close a narrow documentation update while preserving a clear recheck condition.
what_changed: Added a short clarification to the companion artifact documentation.
Recorded the condition under which the closure remains usable.
unresolved: The clarification has not been tested against every downstream reuse context.
This record is not proof that the clarification is true in all settings.
must_preserve: PASS is not a truth guarantee.
Conditional PASS remains a subtype under PASS, not a fourth gate output.
Future restartability depends on the stated validity condition.
restart_point: Recheck whether the stated validity condition still holds before reusing this closure.
stop_condition: Stop if the documented scope no longer matches the actual use context.
Stop if the conditional PASS subtype is treated as proof of truth.
Stop if gate_output is expanded beyond PASS, DELAY, and BLOCK.
reanchor_condition: Re-anchor if scope profiles are redefined.
Re-anchor if the record is reused outside the declared valid_while condition.
next_self_should_not: Do not treat this conditional PASS as a universal approval.
Do not convert conditional_pass into a fourth gate_output.
Do not remove the validity condition to make the record look stronger.
valid_while: The documentation change remains limited to the stated companion artifact scope and is not used as proof of truth.
recheck_by: Before reusing this record for a broader or higher-risk workflow.

responsibility_boundary.responsibility_note: The workflow owner remains responsible for choosing and deploying this conditional PASS.

notes: This is a conditional PASS example under gate_output PASS. It is not proof of truth; it only records a future-restartable closure with an explicit validity condition.
